_help: Magnet Mayhem's painted look: every main button a glossy painted pill (GoButton grey, GoPrimaryButton green — the game's main actions —, GoInfoButton blue, GoDangerButton red, GoSuccessButton green, GoToggleButton grey that turns blue when on), each with a white label outlined in ink; cards, inset boxes, keys and gold or red title ribbons drawn from painted sprites (assets/arcade_light/painted, drawn by GoStyleBoxSprite with the game's 9-slice edges and scales); a white ink-rimmed dropdown, a white notice pill with a blue rim, ink labels and white outlined titles; modal scrims frost the game behind (dial arcade_scrim_blur). Parts with no painted art (rows, fields, tabs, bars) keep the arcade's code-drawn keys in these colours. The colours are the game's UiTheme constants (INK, GOLD, RED, GREEN, CONTROL_BLUE, DIFF_BG, DIFF_SELECTED, BAR_BG, the stage sky, the overlay); the text tokens accent, success, warning, danger and info keep darker readable values, because the game's bright colours are fills, not text on white. The sprite values live in tools/theme_arcade_painted.py (it also writes tools/arcade_painted_map.json, the game's names); the skin is themes/skins/go_skin_arcade_painted.gd. Edit the colours and dials here, then run python3 addons/gohud/tools/make_theme.py arcade_light. The font is the game's (Nunito with Noto Sans CJK fallbacks, written by tools/theme_arcade_painted.py) — 🛑 never set a Latin-only one here: it turns Korean, Japanese and Chinese into empty boxes.
title: Arcade

skin._help: base: arcade_painted (GoSkinArcadePainted — the game's sprites on the parts gohud draws, the arcade's code-drawn keys elsewhere). Dials are numbers you change without touching skin code; delete one and the skin's own value applies.

shape._help: kind, corners and panel opacity only. 🛑 No sizes (gap, padding, button height or padding): a host that pins its own sizes would see its controls change size.

palette._help: The game's UiTheme constants where the role is the same: text and border INK #1D2340, surface white, surface_soft DIFF_BG, surface_high and track BAR_BG, background the stage sky (0.36, 0.62, 0.92), scrim OVERLAY, the *_vivid fills CONTROL_BLUE, GREEN, RED, GOLD and DIFF_SELECTED. accent, success, warning, danger and info are text: the game's colours fail 4.5:1 on white (CONTROL_BLUE 4.4, RED 3.3, GREEN 2.0, GOLD 1.5), so they keep readable values.
